Since we don't use Mockito in test (original comment mentions mock but we used DummyValidator). So remove both import and annotation.

2. In DummyValidator implements JsonValidator, but we need to implement correct method signatures. In networknt schema library, JsonValidator interface has method:

Set<ValidationMessage> validate(JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at) maybe earlier versions. But the compilation feedback says "The current JsonValidator interface expects an ExecutionContext argument as the first parameter." So we added ExecutionContext param, but maybe the interface signature is different: maybe it is validate(JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at) (no ExecutionContext). The error indicates that our method with ExecutionContext does not match. So we need to adjust DummyValidator to implement correct method signature.

Let's check library version. In newer versions of networknt json-schema-validator, JsonValidator interface has method:

Set<ValidationMessage> validate(ExecutionContext executionContext, JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at);

But the compile error says method does not override or implement a method from a supertype, meaning the interface does not have that method signature. So maybe the library version used in this project has older interface without ExecutionContext. So we need to adapt.

We can inspect the library's JsonValidator interface quickly via memory, but assume older version: method signature is:

Set<ValidationMessage> validate(JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at);

Also there is getKeyword().

Thus modify DummyValidator accordingly: remove ExecutionContext param.

Also there may be other @Override in code: line 172 is also DummyValidator's getKeyword? Actually getKeyword is fine. The other @Override at line 172 maybe in another place? The code only has two @Override in DummyValidator. So both cause errors because interface doesn't define those methods with those signatures.

Thus adjust DummyValidator:

private static class DummyValidator implements JsonValidator {
    @Override
    public Set<ValidationMessage> validate(JsonNode node, JsonNode rootNode, String at) {
        return Collections.emptySet();
    }

    @Override
    public String getKeyword() { return "dummy"; }
}

Need to import ValidationMessage, maybe already imported via com.networknt.schema.*? Not imported. Should import com.networknt.schema.ValidationMessage.

Add import.

Also need to import java.util.Collections and Set already imported? Set is imported earlier. Collections imported earlier. So fine.

Now remove Mockito imports and annotation.

Also ensure any other references to MockitoExtension removed.

Now code should compile.

Potential other errors: In provideHasRequiredValidatorDirectManipulation, they call new ObjectMapper().readTree("{}") but they also have mapper static variable. That's fine.

Need to ensure that JsonSchema.from signature matches arguments: (ValidationContext, String id, URI uri, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonSchema parent, boolean something?). In code they pass null for parent, false for something. Should compile.

Also method createChildSchema returns JsonSchema. Good.

Any other compile errors? The code uses ExecutionContext import not present; after removing ExecutionContext param, we need to remove import? Not imported. So fine.

Also we used ValidationMessage import.

Now final code.
